boardroom_read: do-not-automate-promotion: Review 3 approval packets and record approve, reject, or hold decisions. Quality status: pass. Allowed gates: none.
strongest_argument: Promotion would unlock drafts, delivery planning, and pipeline learning faster.
strongest_objection: Automatic promotion would collapse Daniel approval into automation and weaken the central safety control.
uncomfortable_truth: The approval bottleneck is intentional; removing it would make the engine less trustworthy.
allowed_next_move: Review approval packets and record approve, reject, or hold.
blocked_actions: Automatic promotion, outreach approval, proposal sending, or treating a council verdict as consent.
daniel_decision_needed: Daniel must decide approve, reject, or hold for each promotion packet.
notes: CEO council brief is advisory; it cannot approve promotion, outreach, remote GitHub writes, publishing, billing, or client-facing claims.

boardroom_read: defer-until-prospect-approved: Resolve missing gates; Daniel must approve exact recipient, channel, and copy before any send. Quality status: pass. Allowed gates: none.
strongest_argument: Drafting early could make the engine feel ready and shorten turnaround after promotion.
strongest_objection: Drafting against unapproved businesses risks weak relevance, compliance gaps, and accidental send pressure.
uncomfortable_truth: Generic outreach readiness is false readiness if the prospect and contact basis are not approved.
allowed_next_move: Wait for approved prospects, then regenerate drafts and pre-send checks.
blocked_actions: Email, SMS, DM, contact form, call, social post, scheduling, or follow-up.
daniel_decision_needed: Daniel must approve the prospect, exact copy, channel, contact basis, sender ID, and opt-out before send.
notes: CEO council brief is advisory; it cannot approve promotion, outreach, remote GitHub writes, publishing, billing, or client-facing claims.

boardroom_read: test-smaller-source-route: Run research-only query "The Mill Gallery" "Yeppoon" Facebook Instagram website; capture only if public business-owned social/profile, region fit, and website-gap evidence are all present; otherwise log the failed attempt. Quality status: pass. Allowed gates: Run safe prospect research, Capture sourced intake candidate.
strongest_argument: Broad search is fast and can surface unknown businesses without hand-curated directories.
strongest_objection: Broad search has repeatedly returned locality pages; repeating it burns time and creates false confidence.
uncomfortable_truth: The engine needs better source discipline more than it needs more broad searching.
allowed_next_move: Run a research-only source-route test and log the result.
blocked_actions: Contacting, following, liking, messaging, scraping behind login, or capturing weak evidence.
daniel_decision_needed: No Daniel decision needed for safe public research; Daniel approval needed before promotion or outreach.
notes: CEO council brief is advisory; it cannot approve promotion, outreach, remote GitHub writes, publishing, billing, or client-facing claims.

boardroom_read: keep-local-only: Review 3 local readiness rows; ask for exact approval only if Daniel wants remote issues. Quality status: pass. Allowed gates: none.
strongest_argument: Remote issues would make review and tracking easier in GitHub.
strongest_objection: Remote issue creation is an external write and should not happen just because local artifacts are ready.
uncomfortable_truth: A polished local command is still an external action when it touches GitHub remotely.
allowed_next_move: Keep GitHub issue work local until remote write approval exists.
blocked_actions: Creating, editing, or pushing remote GitHub issues without exact approval.
daniel_decision_needed: Daniel must explicitly approve any remote GitHub write.
notes: CEO council brief is advisory; it cannot approve promotion, outreach, remote GitHub writes, publishing, billing, or client-facing claims.

boardroom_read: keep-private: Use 8 private concepts only for internal review until promotion and outreach approval exist. Quality status: pass. Allowed gates: none.
strongest_argument: A visible concept can make the offer tangible and speed up buyer understanding.
strongest_objection: Publishing or sending unsolicited concepts can imply endorsement and create reputational risk.
uncomfortable_truth: A pretty mockup can become reputational risk if the business did not ask to see it.
allowed_next_move: Keep concepts private and use them only for internal review.
blocked_actions: Publishing, sending, or implying endorsement of private concept sites.
daniel_decision_needed: Daniel must approve any client-facing publication, send, demo, hosting, or claim.
notes: CEO council brief is advisory; it cannot approve promotion, outreach, remote GitHub writes, publishing, billing, or client-facing claims.

boardroom_read: keep-model-with-scope-control: Use 15 offer strategy rows and 4 forecast stages without treating forecast as booked revenue. Quality status: pass. Allowed gates: none.
strongest_argument: $0 upfront lowers friction for small local businesses and keeps offers easy to understand.
strongest_objection: A low-friction offer can attract low-commitment buyers if trust, scope, and cancellation terms are unclear.
uncomfortable_truth: Low upfront friction only works if scope, support load, and trust are controlled.
allowed_next_move: Keep the flat monthly model, but protect scope and claims.
blocked_actions: Invoices, charges, signed proposal claims, revenue guarantees, or booked-revenue assumptions.
daniel_decision_needed: Daniel must approve proposal sending, client promises, invoices, or charges.
notes: CEO council brief is advisory; it cannot approve promotion, outreach, remote GitHub writes, publishing, billing, or client-facing claims.
